## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/stringtooffsettable">StringToOffsetTable</a> - This class uniques a bunch of nul-terminated strings and keeps track of their offset in a massive contiguous string allocation.</p>


<p>It can then output this string blob and use indexes into the string to reference each piece.</p>
